Sanctioned notary public commission with notarial society attestation counts it as a commission the society renews after protocol audits. The cedar is the old receipt — a fee sent years ago to an office that files its own copy and never throws one away. A hundred fake histories need a hundred fake payment trails, and the tundra is the first trail's cost: real money, to a real institution, on a date the institution remembers. The umber is the institution's own ledger, which the applicant has never touched.
